title: CppCon 2015: Greg Law " Give me 15 minutes & I'll change your view of GDB"
summary: Greg Law's 15-minute CppCon 2015 lightning talk shows what GDB can do beyond basic use, including its text user interface and reverse debugging.
why: Recommended as a fast, brilliant introduction to GDB's TUI mode and lesser-known features, useful for anyone who has only used IDE debuggers.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: this brilliant short talk (15min) about gdb's TUI.
